create_delta_distribution: create a Delta distribution with a tensor value and optional log_density for MAP estimation
sample_from_delta: sample from a Delta distribution using rsample to get the deterministic value expanded to sample shape
compute_log_prob_delta: compute the log probability of a value against a Delta distribution with added log_density
expand_delta_distribution: expand a Delta distribution to a new batch shape while preserving event shape
get_delta_mean_variance: get the mean and variance properties of a Delta distribution returning value and zeros
